faq.title: Answers before you start.
faq.intro: Essential answers about deployment, payments, hosting, maintenance and how MarketSoft can evolve.

items.q: How long does it take to launch the platform?
items.a: The Essential offer is planned around one week, the Advanced offer around ten days, and the marketplace between two and four weeks. Custom timing depends on the scope.
Yes. A payment method can be integrated depending on the package, country and selected provider.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Yes. MarketSoft is designed to be deployed under your company identity and domain.
Yes. The architecture is designed to add capabilities, integrations, sellers, languages or points of sale progressively.
The platform can be hosted in the environment defined with you. The exact terms are specified in the offer and maintenance agreement.
The maintenance scope is defined according to the selected package and can cover monitoring, updates, backups, security and support.

items.q: I already have a site — will I lose my data when migrating to MarketSoft?
items.a: No. Your product or service catalog, your customers and your order history are carried over before the new site goes live — nothing is re-entered by hand. The exact scope depends on the format and quality of the data available on your current platform.

items.q: Will I lose my Google ranking when changing sites?
items.a: No, your links keep working after the switch thanks to redirects set up during migration. In most cases, ranking actually improves thanks to a faster, better-structured site.

items.q: Will my site go down during the transition?
items.a: No. The new site is prepared and tested while the old one keeps running normally. The switch happens at a time you choose, with no interruption to your sales.

items.q: I already pay a monthly subscription on my current platform — what changes with MarketSoft?
items.a: Your site belongs to you: there's no mandatory monthly rent to a foreign platform that can raise its prices or change its rules at any time. Costs are split between the initial setup and an annual maintenance and support fee, known in advance.

items.q: Will my team have to relearn everything?
items.a: Training is included at launch, along with close follow-up right after going live to quickly answer any question or fine-tune the setup.

items.q: Can you connect my store to my usual carrier?
items.a: Yes. Simply put us in touch with your delivery provider and we take care of connecting order tracking to your store.

items.q: Do you also manage my social media?
items.a: On the Advanced and Marketplace packages, managing the social media linked to your store can be handled by our team. It's an option available in the "Options & support" section of each package.

items.q: Is artificial intelligence available on all packages?
items.a: AI features (automatic product page writing, suggested review replies, personalized recommendations, automatic statistics summaries) are offered as part of the Custom package, built to your specific needs.
Ownership, hosting and usage terms are defined contractually according to the selected project and support model.
